stories.title: UK Government letter to Uniper asks if Connah’s Quay power station plan does enough for Dee Estuary wildlife
stories.summary: The UK Government has written to Uniper asking whether its plans would make up for the saltmarsh and curlew habitat that would be lost to a new power station at Connah’s Quay. stories.title: Wok & Go franchise boss from Higher Kinnerton given suspended sentence for breaching director ban

stories.title: Plans submitted to demolish and rebuild Latter-day Saints church on St David’s Park, Ewloe
stories.summary: A church that opened in Ewloe in 2005 could be demolished and replaced with a building about twice the size, under plans submitted to Flintshire County Council. stories.title: Flintshire Council tips could charge for soil, rubble and gas bottles to help cut overspend
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council could charge people for taking soil, rubble and gas bottles to its recycling centres under an option drawn up to help cut its overspend.
